description:
Search every asset source of this server's engine, live; earlier sources rank first. Read-only — never creates a revision.

Returns JSON `{ sources: [{ source, description, total, nextPage, failed, assets }] }`; each asset has `id`, `label`, `mimeType`, `uri` and `groups`, an image its `width` and `height` in pixels, and a typeface asset (e.g. from the `ly.img.gfonts` Google Fonts source) a compact `typeface: { name, weights, styles }`. A source's `description` says what it holds. Typefaces: `mimeType: ['application/ubq-typeface']`.

The `ly.img.workspace.images` source is this workspace's own store: every image the agent generated or imported AND every image the human uploaded in the browser editor, newest first. Uploads carry their original filename as `label` (the human will refer to it — "use logo-final.png" — so search that name) and `groups: ["uploads"]`. "The image the user just uploaded" = the first asset in the `uploads` group.

⚠ Asset sources are deployment configuration — where their content lives (IMG.LY CDN, a customer host) is the server's business. NEVER fetch asset manifests (`content.json`) or hardcode `cdn.img.ly` URLs yourself; this tool and the uris it returns are the only correct path. A source this tool does not name is not available on this server — say so instead of working around it.

To USE a result, apply it inside `edit` code — either:
(A) new block: `await engine.design.create({ type: 'graphic', props: { shape: { type: 'rect' }, fill: { type: 'image', uri }, width, height, contentFill: { mode: 'Cover' } } }, { parent: page })` with the asset's `uri` — keep `width`:`height` at the asset's aspect, or let `Cover` crop a photo; a logo or other mark takes `{ mode: 'Contain' }`; audio: `{ type: 'audio', props: { audio: { fileURI: uri } } }`;
(B) existing block: `await engine.design.setProps(blockId, { fill: { type: 'image', uri }, contentFill: { mode: 'Cover' } })` with the asset's `uri` — `Cover` fills the frame and crops what does not fit, right for a photo; a logo or mark takes `{ mode: 'Contain' }`, or a frame at its `width`:`height`, so it is never cut.
(C) fonts: set the family BY NAME inside `edit` — `text: { font: { family: name, weight: 'normal' } }` in `engine.design.create` or `engine.design.setProps`; the edit API finds the family and loads the weight. Never copy font URIs out of this tool into edit code.

groups.description: Only assets in one of these groups.

mimeType.description: Only these types: exact (`image/png`) or a family (`image/*`).

query.description: Words to find in labels and tags. Omit to list.

source.description: Only this source, as a result named it.

name: asset_search
